## How I checked it

## Safety
- [ ] Touches a safety module (guard, supervisor, homing, confirm, watchdog, speedprofile, jobcontrol) and has tests for it
- [ ] `SAFETY_RULES.md` / README updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets or personal data in the diff
